OBJECT Codeunit 50021 Redundant Parens
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE CheckExpr@1(FlagP@1000 : Boolean;QtyP@1001 : Decimal) Result : Boolean;
    VAR
      TotalL@1002 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // CAL021: redundant outer and atomic parens removed
      IF (FlagP) THEN
        TotalL := (QtyP) + (1);

      // CAL021: duplicate parens removed, required AND comparison parens MUST remain!
      IF ((QtyP > 0) AND (TotalL > 0)) THEN
        Result := TRUE;

      // CAL021: NOT (comparison) parens MUST remain!
      IF NOT (QtyP = 0) THEN
        EXIT((Result));
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
